newsitem.title: USA: UST Inc to unveil discount snuff - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: UST Inc to unveil discount snuff - WSJ.

text.p: UST Inc is expected to announce a discount snuff called Red Seal within weeks, The Wall Street Journal said.

In Monday's electronic edition, the paper cited industry analysts saying that UST has shelved consideration of across the board discounts because of sensitivities raised by the proposed tobacco-industry settlement.
The analysts said that UST is expected to begin distributing the 25-cents-off coupons for its biggest brands in markets where cheaper rivals have taken off, according to the article.
Such coupons would equal eight percent of the price of an average can, the paper said.
UST declined comment, the article said.
